data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: Dışarı bak! "Raining cats and dogs" olduğundan şemsiyeyi al!

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = bardaktan boşanırcasına yağmak. Örnek: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
